# Workflows that declare workflow_dispatch but are not yet on the
# default branch (#644), enforced by scripts/check-dispatch-reachable.sh.
#
# GitHub only exposes a dispatchable workflow from the DEFAULT branch.
# This project develops on `dev` and releases to `main`, and `main` is
# the default, so a new dispatch-only workflow is undispatchable for one
# release cycle after it merges. That is normal; being undispatchable
# and DOCUMENTED AS A ROUTE is not.
#
# Rules:
#   - An entry requires a reason and what clears it. No bare paths.
#   - The documentation for the workflow must say it is not available
#     yet, for as long as the entry is here.
#   - The gate fails when an entry stops being needed — the workflow
#     reached the default branch, so remove the entry. An allowlist
#     nobody prunes is how a temporary exception becomes permanent.
#
